title: Single-Cell Transcriptomic and Regulatory Network Analyses Identify a Putative HNF4A-OXR1 Association Linked to Podocyte Mitochondrial Dysfunction in Diabetic Kidney Disease.
authors: Yang, Zhenkun; Jiang, Shimin; Cui, Wen; Zhou, Jiahui; Li, Wenge
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合单核RNA-seq与机器学习、转录因子富集及分子对接，预测HNF4A-OXR1调控关系与足细胞线粒体功能障碍，但核心为转录组与调控网络分析，缺乏TF-DNA三维互作建模或结合机制研究，仅部分涉及蛋白-DNA互作。
abstract: Podocyte injury is a central pathological event in diabetic kidney disease (DKD), but the mitochondrial regulatory mechanisms underlying podocyte dysfunction remain incompletely defined. We integrated single-nucleus RNA-seq data from human renal biopsies in GSE195460 with podocyte-specific differential expression, functional enrichment, mitochondrial gene annotation, co-expression network analysis, machine learning feature selection, pseudotime analysis, in silico knockout, transcription factor enrichment, motif analysis, and molecular docking; findings were externally evaluated in GSE209781. Podocytes showed prominent disease-associated transcriptomic perturbation, with 677 exploratory cell-level differentially expressed genes and enrichment of cytoskeletal, adhesion, developmental, oxidative phosphorylation, and metabolic pathways. Thirty-one mitochondrial-related differentially expressed genes were identified, and OXR1 was prioritized as a candidate regulatory hub based on consistent downregulation, network centrality, machine learning selection, and external validation. HNF4A was predicted as an upstream regulator linked to OXR1 and other mitochondrial targets. In silico OXR1 perturbation increased the predicted injured-state probability from 15% to 82%, while promoter motif analysis provided additional computational support for a putative HNF4A-OXR1 regulatory relationship. These findings highlight OXR1 as a candidate associated with podocyte mitochondrial dysfunction in DKD and suggest a putative HNF4A-OXR1 regulatory relationship.
abstract_zh: 足细胞损伤是糖尿病肾病（DKD）中的一个核心病理事件，但足细胞功能障碍背后的线粒体调控机制仍未完全明确。我们整合了来自GSE195460中人类肾活检的单核RNA测序数据，并结合足细胞特异性差异表达、功能富集、线粒体基因注释、共表达网络分析、机器学习特征选择、伪时间分析、计算机模拟敲除、转录因子富集、基序分析和分子对接；研究结果在GSE209781中进行了外部评估。足细胞表现出显著疾病相关的转录组扰动，鉴定出677个探索性细胞水平差异表达基因，并富集了细胞骨架、黏附、发育、氧化磷酸化和代谢通路。共识别出31个线粒体相关差异表达基因，其中OXR1基于一致性下调、网络中心性、机器学习选择和外部验证被优先确定为候选调控枢纽。HNF4A被预测为与OXR1及其他线粒体靶标相关的上游调控因子。计算机模拟OXR1扰动将预测的损伤状态概率从15%提高至82%，而启动子基序分析为假定的HNF4A-OXR1调控关系提供了额外的计算支持。这些发现强调OXR1是与DKD中足细胞线粒体功能障碍相关的候选基因，并提示存在假定的HNF4A-OXR1调控关系。
